_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Report
summary: Documents the data required to substantiate the materials and processes used to develop materiel, ensuring system performance requirements are met throughout the system's operational service life.
use_relationship:
The Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Report documents the data required to substantiate the materials and processes used to develop materiel. The data will be used to substantiate the materiel's design to ensure system performance requirements are met throughout the system's operational service life.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.

This DID interfaces with DI-SESS-82236A, Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Plan.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82237.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Testing Methods for Material Properties
Describe the results from all research and development
children.content: Describe the results from all research and development, testing, and fabrication studies accomplished with respect to materials and processes development.

children.title: Describe the results from conducting materials testing
children.content: Describe the results from conducting materials testing.

children.title: Describe the work performed to support the evaluation
children.content: Describe the work performed to support the evaluation and substantiation of material properties.

children.title: Describe the results from developing non-destructive test accept/reject
children.content: Describe the results from developing non-destructive test accept/reject criteria, materials processing effects and parameters, material fabrication techniques, and manufacturing procedures.

children.title: Describe the ability to meet program specific test
children.content: Describe the ability to meet program specific test objectives, test methods, test procedures, test conditions, and test matrices proposed in the Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Plan.

children.title: Describe the data generated to validate the methods
children.content: Describe the data generated to validate the methods being used in the testing and evaluation of materials.

children.title: Describe the data generated from materials testing and
children.content: Describe the data generated from materials testing and evaluation to ensure that materials and processes are characterized in a statistically significant manner relative to the design application.

children.title: Material Properties Testing Plans and Procedures
Describe the data available to substantiate that the
children.content: Describe the data available to substantiate that the testing and evaluation strategy supports the building block approach (coupon, element, sub component). Describe the rationale for using approaches other than the building block approach.

children.title: Describe the data available to substantiate the implementation
children.content: Describe the data available to substantiate the implementation of procedures used for monitoring and controlling processes critical to satisfying part design requirements.

children.title: Describe the process for identifying, monitoring, controlling, and
children.content: Describe the process for identifying, monitoring, controlling, and analyzing key process parameters.

children.title: Describe the process for determining and evaluating process
children.content: Describe the process for determining and evaluating process capability, including management and reduction of process variation.

children.title: Describe the methodology used to determine and substantiate
children.content: Describe the methodology used to determine and substantiate thermal exposure time histories.

children.title: Describe the data to substantiate composite sandwich construction
children.content: Describe the data to substantiate composite sandwich construction properties, including those analytically derived from sandwich constituent properties to permit for the statistical determination of the material properties.

children.title: Describe the methodology and results for process verification testing
children.content: Describe the methodology and results for process verification testing of test coupons (representative of the production part) and their associated acceptance criteria.

children.title: Material Properties Test Schedule
children.content: Describe the materials and processes testing schedule that includes the characterization, testing, and analysis planned with respect to critical path milestones against the contractor's integrated master schedule.

children.title: Material Properties Substantiation
Describe the methods used to substantiate material properties
children.content: Describe the methods used to substantiate material properties by using standardized documentation, analyses, tests, and inspections to characterize the following properties: static strength, fatigue strength, modulus, effect of stress concentrations, fracture toughness, crack growth, impact resistance, effects of defects, resistance to environmentally-assisted cracking, wear, general corrosion, pitting, stress corrosion cracking, exfoliation, galvanic corrosion, crevice corrosion, filiform corrosion, moisture absorption, chemical, solvent, fuel, and lubricant exposure; hydrolytic instability, thermal exposure, electromagnetic compatibility, adhesion strength, peel resistance, dielectric constant, resistivity, glass transition temperature, and erosion.

children.title: Describe the data to substantiate the effects of
children.content: Describe the data to substantiate the effects of environmental exposure and operating environment on material properties.

children.title: Describe the data to substantiate materials specifications selected
children.content: Describe the data to substantiate materials specifications selected for protective finishes, protective coatings and sealants for corrosion protection.

children.title: Material Allowables Development
Describe the design allowable philosophy used to develop
children.content: Describe the design allowable philosophy used to develop the system materials, and document how the data was generated and used to determine material properties.

children.title: Describe the analytical procedures used to calculate static
children.content: Describe the analytical procedures used to calculate static and dynamic material allowables.

children.title: Describe the static material allowables methodology in statistical
children.content: Describe the static material allowables methodology in statistical terms of confidence levels and exceedance values.

children.title: Describe the methodology used to substantiate the impact
children.content: Describe the methodology used to substantiate the impact of inorganic finish systems on material allowables.

children.title: Describe the methods used to generate composite laminate data
children.content: Describe the methods used to generate composite laminate data (including data analytically derived from single-ply properties) to permit for a statistical determination of the laminate properties.

children.title: Describe the data to substantiate the materials' fracture toughness
children.content: Describe the data to substantiate the materials' fracture toughness values to be used in the residual strength analysis of metallic parts will be the minimum substantiated fracture toughness values.
